A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we design, implement and evaluate Scotch, a new SDN architecture that uses vSwitch based overlays to increase the control plane capacity and the SDN network resiliency.

Scotch is able to scale up the control plane throughput of an SDN network to 100 Gbps, and can achieve 10x higher throughput than the best existing solution, and 5x higher throughput than an SDN network that uses a single controller with a single control plane.
we propose a novel solution that enables the control plane to scale up its throughput capacity elastically.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a vSwitch-based SDN overlay can significantly increase the network control plane capacity.
it is possible to use vSwitches to elastically scale up the control plane, and that this solution can provide high performance and resiliency.
the control plane of SDN can be scaled up by using commodity vSwitches as a scalable overlay for the control path, which is an alternative to using more powerful controllers.
